label: Todoist
description: Task and to-do management through the Todoist unified API.
notes: Endpoints use the unified API (api.todoist.com/api/v1) that the piece itself targets; the two replaced live nodes were on the deprecated rest/v2 base URL, and the live createTask always sent "due_string": "" when the due field was blank, which Todoist rejects. Credential kept as TODOIST_API_TOKEN (not TODOIST_ACCESS_TOKEN per the OAuth2 mapping rule) to preserve continuity with the existing live Todoist nodes' credential wiring; both personal API tokens and OAuth2 access tokens work as the Bearer value. Simplifications: create/update drop optional labels (JSON array), priority (JSON integer), project_id/section_id (API rejects empty strings), and the piece's due_string/due_date/due_datetime branching logic — templates cannot emit typed values or conditionally include keys; a separate createTaskInProject node restores project targeting by making project_id required. updateTask is reduced to rewriting content only, since sending other optional keys as empty strings would wipe them. find_task's paginated fetch-all + exact-name match is needsPieceRuntime; searchTasks covers the use case in one request via the filter endpoint (first page only). listTasks and searchTasks return the first result page only (no cursor pagination).
